phase: 3 since 2026-09-29 (Phase 3 integration, Q fix round 1); the orchestrator sets it to 1, 2, 3 after each phase merges. A scope listed in
mustBeZeroByPhase[p] for every p <= phase must have zero banned-string hits ('*' = every scope).
Preview a later phase without editing this file: node ci/static-checks.mjs --phase 1

bannedStrings: hits per scope (absent = 0; c95cc03 counts ratcheted down after each phase; 2026-09-29 final QA round 1: every scope 0, the last hit ("(bundle)" 1, the slug ZX_BLOG_AGENTS_OPS) was fixed by S3). A PR fails if any scope rises. Owning streams lower their
own scopes with: node ci/banned-strings.mjs --write-baseline (never raises). Inspect: node ci/banned-strings.mjs --hits <scope>

styleAttributes: max count of style=" in the bundle (2,196 at c95cc03; 1,229 after Phase 3; 1,017 after the Phase 3 integration merge of rd/h, a447c24, 2026-09-29); 1,016 after final QA round 3 (bb6a765, 2026-09-30); node ci/launch.mjs --write-weight lowers it together with the weight ceilings.
undefinedVars: var(--z*) names used without a fallback and defined nowhere at c95cc03; S1's token block defines them,
then remove them here. Any other undefined name fails.
smokeOverflow390: ci/smoke.mjs rect-overflow ratchet, outermost offending elements per page at 390px (c95cc03 counts on production;
every page 0 since the final QA round 1, 2026-09-29, when all five measured 0). Fails when a page gets worse; from phase 3 every count must be 0 (launch precondition 6).
Exempt hits (not counted; ci/banned-strings.mjs header): facts data, DEAD_FUNCTIONS (verified unreachable on every run),
URL/path tokens, DATED_EXEMPTIONS (renderPrivacyV7 'SOC 2 Type II certification', A2P-frozen) and VERIFY_EXEMPTIONS ('$936,988,750' on /press, [VERIFY]).
List them: node ci/banned-strings.mjs --exempt; reachability report: node ci/banned-strings.mjs --dead
weight (final QA round 1, 2026-09-29; ci/launch.mjs): ceilings = failing ratchet on brotli-4 bytes of the SOURCE stylesheet and of bundle + stylesheet (what production loads today),
and on @import rules in the stylesheet (measured + 2,048 B headroom at d3cd1fe; lower with node ci/launch.mjs --write-weight, never raise without a reason in the PR). targets = the launch item
'weight': production's bundle + stylesheet at c95cc03 (362,039 B brotli-4), a 30 KB stylesheet, no @import, compared with the DEPLOY BUILD (ci/build.mjs) since final QA round 2.
RAISED by hand in final QA round 2 (2026-09-29, Q): ceilings.totalBr4 405,675 -> 412,698 (= 410,650 measured at 851218d + 2,048). The d3cd1fe ceiling was set on the base while ten
round-1 branches that grow the bundle were in flight: the round-1 a11y, form-validation and link fixes grew the bundle by S2 +9,084, S3 +7,823, P6 +5,529, P1 +4,928, P4 +2,267 B raw
(each within DESIGN_SPEC 7.4's 15 KB per stream), so rd/final failed the plain CI run (audit/final_suite_r1.md 1). From now on the ceilings are re-measured with --write-weight after
the LAST merge of a round, never on the base while branches are in flight. ceilings.cssBr4 (69,070; 64,083 measured) is left alone for the same reason.
builtCeilings (final QA round 2): the same ratchet on the deploy build (ci/build.mjs, whitespace-only minification; 347,120 B brotli-4 at 851218d + 2,048). --write-weight lowers
both sets and adds builtCeilings.cssBr4 on its first run after the last merge of round 2. When a round's accepted growth passes a ceiling, the orchestrator runs
node ci/launch.mjs --remeasure-weight --reason "…" after that round's last merge: every ceiling = measured + 2,048, up or down, logged in weight.log with the reason.

Final QA polish round (2026-09-30, Q): --write-weight run on rd/final bb6a765 after round 3's last merge (cssBr4 61,166, totalBr4 410,610, cssImports 0; built totalBr4 346,360, cssBr4 42,370; styleAttributes 1,016); it now also lowers styleAttributes and logs each run in weight.log. Re-run it after the polish round's last merge.
launchSignoffs: orchestrator decisions on open launch items (ci/launch.mjs), keyed by item id, e.g. "dead-code": {"by": "orchestrator", "date": "…", "note": "…"}.
Every open item prints as a LAUNCH line in ci/static-checks.mjs; node ci/static-checks.mjs --launch fails while an item is open and not signed off (launch precondition 6).
